request: Give me an original Listen to an Announcement practice set.
expects: identifies Listen to an Announcement
uses an original classroom or campus-related announcement
asks about purpose organization detail or next action
states the modality and withholds the transcript or key as appropriate

request: Announcement: 'Because the west entrance is being repaired, the library will open through the garden door this weekend. Hours remain unchanged.' I said the purpose is to announce shorter library hours. Coach me.
expects: identifies the temporary entrance change as the purpose
cites hours remain unchanged
distinguishes the repair reason from the listener action
offers a purpose retry

request: The speaker first says presentations start Tuesday, then corrects this to Thursday because the hall is unavailable. I answered Tuesday. Explain the error.
expects: identifies Thursday as the updated detail
uses the correction and reason as evidence
names old-versus-updated information as the error pattern
offers a changed-detail retry

request: Announcement: 'Lab coats will be distributed outside Room 12 before the safety session. Students without a coat should arrive ten minutes early.' What should a student without a coat do?
expects: answers arrive ten minutes early
connects the instruction to coat distribution before the session
does not add an unsupported requirement
explains the purpose-to-action relationship

request: I cannot play audio. Give me an accessible announcement practice alternative.
expects: provides a structured transcript alternative
labels it as content or organization practice
states that audio decoding and prosody are untested
keeps questions and options screen-reader compatible
